landing.heroHeadline: From your first intention to your last step — a guide that walks with you
landing.heroSub: A step-by-step ritual planner, Tawaf counter, AI-powered Q&A, and emergency contacts — built for pilgrims, tested by pilgrims.
landing.loginLink: Already have an account? Log in
landing.howSub: From preparation to completion — each phase has its own steps, duas, and guidance tailored to you.
landing.featureGuideDesc: Follow each rite with detailed descriptions, locations, common mistakes to avoid, and audio duas.
landing.featurePlannerDesc: Enter your age, health, and travel mode. We generate a custom plan with notes tailored to your needs.
landing.featureCounterDesc: Tap to count each circuit. Visual progress ring and completion alerts keep you on track.
landing.featureChatbotDesc: Get instant answers about rituals, Ihram rules, duas, and locations. Trained specifically for Hajj and Umrah.
landing.featureMultilingualDesc: The entire app switches between Arabic, English, and Urdu — including RTL layout for Arabic and Urdu.
landing.featureEmergencyDesc: Medical centres, helplines, and embassy numbers for Makkah and Madinah — cached for offline access.
landing.stage1Desc: Pack, plan, and set your intention. Our checklist and planner get you ready before you leave.
landing.stage2Desc: Enter the state of Ihram at the Miqat with the correct intention and recitations.
landing.stage3Desc: Follow each step — Tawaf, Sa'i, standing at Arafat, stoning, and more — with live counters and guidance.
landing.stage4Desc: Complete your rites, perform the farewell Tawaf, and carry the blessings home.
landing.featuresSub: Six tools designed around the real needs of pilgrims — from planning to packing to prayer.
landing.demoHint: Click Arabic, English, or Urdu — every label, every page, every tool follows. RTL layout adapts automatically.
landing.privacyDesc: Your data is encrypted and never shared. We only store what's needed for your plan and checklist — no tracking, no ads, no third-party access.
landing.offlineDesc: Core content — ritual steps, duas, and emergency contacts — is cached on your device. Access it even without internet in Makkah and Madinah.
landing.footerTagline: Your companion through the sacred journey.
